title: Minecraft Wiki gameplay and tutorials
content_excerpt: Minecraft Wiki provides tutorials covering gameplay mechanics, farming, mob management, enchanting, smelting, mechanisms, and technical topics.
evidence_notes: Primary community reference for converting general Minecraft gameplay knowledge into decision knowledge. Must not be copied wholesale; only short evidence excerpts and synthesized decision rules are stored.
notes: Seed source. Tutorials often describe community practice rather than a normative rule; knowledge derived from them must remain draft until verified.
